changes.before: Implement readLabel with the supplied LoadError class. Return a valid string label; wrap JSON parse or wrong-label-type failures with new LoadError("Cannot load label", originalCause). Append "finished" exactly once on success or failure.
changes.after: Keep the cause of an error and run a final step on both success and failure.

before: A custom LoadError extends Error. super(message,{cause}) supplies the error message and retains the original thrown value in the cause property; {cause} is shorthand for {cause:cause}. Setting name makes the diagnostic category explicit. Constructing an error does not throw it until throw is used.

readLabel(raw,events) parses JSON text, returns a string label if valid, or throws a LoadError wrapping a parse/shape failure. JSON.parse returns a decoded value or throws SyntaxError. data?.label reads label unless data is null or undefined, in which case it yields undefined. The explicit type guard rejects non-string labels with TypeError. finally appends "finished" to the supplied event array whether the try returned or threw; push returns the new length, which we ignore.

A return or throw inside finally can replace an earlier result or failure, so this finally only records completion. Optional practice: use valid {"label":"Sky"} input and explain why the returned string and the finished event both occur.
after:
A custom error can add a useful name and message while keeping the original problem.

Our `LoadError` extends `Error`. `super(message, {cause})` saves the message and the original error as `cause`. Creating the error is separate from throwing it.

`readLabel` parses JSON and checks that its label is text. Broken JSON throws a `SyntaxError`. A wrong label type causes our own `TypeError`.

`data?.label` gives `undefined` when data is null or undefined, so the type check can reject it safely.

The `finally` block adds `"finished"` to the event list on success or failure.

Complete `readLabel(raw, events)`. Return a valid string label. Wrap failures in `new LoadError("Cannot load label", cause)`.

Add `"finished"` exactly once in `finally`. Do not return or throw from that block: doing so could replace the earlier result or error.
